page.overview:
Who is Shiva?

Shiva is a recurring summon and boss in the Chocobo series.

Shiva can be summoned with the Shiva Spirit Stone. She does Ice-elemental damage.

Shiva can be summoned with a Summon Stone and can partner up with Chocobo when a Shiva Summon feather is used. Her attacks as a partner are Slap and Blizzard. She is able to block moves with ice shards and is vulnerable to fire spells.

Shiva appears as a boss in the Guardian of the Dark's Dungeon Floor 30 and as one of the Duel Trap opponents in the Guardian of the Water 21-30. Defeating her rewards Chocobo with the Shiva Magicite. A summoning stone that does a low-damage ice attack in a 3-grid radius and casts Sleep spell.
